title: Dramatic Storm Waves Crashing on Coastal Tower
place: Stormy coast with a lattice navigation-marker tower (location not given on page)
notes: Tripod-ish long-lens shot in a storm, dusk-blue light. A red/black lattice marker tower stands on a jetty at x~0.53-0.58, y~0.1-0.35; foam everywhere below. 0-2.5 s: big brown-tinged breakers roll in from the left toward the tower. 3-4.5 s: a wave hits the jetty and its spray climbs the tower (x~0.45-0.65, y~0.2-0.4). 4.5-6.5 s: spray and white water bury the tower's base / jetty entirely; 7-11 s: sea keeps overwashing, tower stands in the foam. Source 23.976 fps 4K -> 30 fps 1080p. No people, text or logos. Shot A 0.5-3.0 s, Shot B 3.0-5.7 s.
fact_en: Page description: "Powerful storm waves crash dramatically against a coastal ocean tower."
